nodes.label: Proveedores capability (proveedores)
nodes.rationale: Greenfield capability: supplier catalog with estatus machine, accounts (ProveedorFormaPagoCuenta), staging/authorization flow, GenerarDiff; caratula-per-account data model and re-authorization semantics live here.

nodes.label: Per-account caratula ownership
nodes.rationale: An account MUST own exactly one OPTIONAL caratula stored as caratula_path on the account row (live + staging); a caratula belongs to exactly one account; suppliers with no accounts cannot hold one.

nodes.label: Caratula staging for authorized suppliers
nodes.rationale: Upload on Aprobado/EditadoPendiente enters full staging (live caratula_path unchanged, estatus flips to EditadoPendiente, change goes live only on approval); Nuevo prospecto writes directly; GenerarDiff emits one CampoDiff per changed account.
